decisions.reason: As a compliance-oriented product line that fits the firm's stated expansion into compliance capabilities and has remained visible for two years, management would keep the option open because signals are positive enough and the likely carrying cost is modest.

Because this platform is presented as a flagship on the home page and sits at the core of the firm's agency-focused direction, management would continue backing it rather than abandon a strategically central option.
This managed hosting plan is very close to the established business, has stayed on the website across both years, and likely costs little extra to maintain, so management would keep it on the market.

As a newly launched security-related extension tightly linked to the hosting base, its uncertainty is still resolving and the cost of keeping it available is likely low, so management would not drop it yet.
